description:
Acme Corp has issued an Energy Saver configuration profile (PayloadIdentifier **com.apple.MCX**, PayloadType **com.apple.MCX**) titled **“Energy Saver Settings.”** The profile description matches the display name, and it is version 1 with UUID **A1B2C3D4-1234-ABCD-5678-9ABCDEF01234**. For security, the FileVault key is set to be destroyed on standby (DestroyFVKeyOnStandby = true), while normal sleep functionality remains enabled (SleepDisabled = false).

The desktop AC power profile (profile number 1) disables automatic restart after power loss, enables disk‑sleep, and sets the display to sleep after 10 minutes and the system after 20 minutes; Wake‑On‑LAN is disabled. A daily schedule runs a shutdown at 22:00 on all weekdays (weekdays = 31) and wakes the machine each morning at 08:00 on the same days. For portable devices, the AC power profile (profile number 2) also disables automatic restart, leaves disk‑sleep off, and uses a 5‑minute display‑sleep and 15‑minute system‑sleep timer, with Wake‑On‑LAN disabled. The battery‑power profile (profile number 3) again disables automatic restart, enables disk‑sleep, and applies a 3‑minute display‑sleep and 10‑minute system‑sleep timer, with Wake‑On‑LAN disabled.
